learning_rate: linear 0.01 to 0.001; fresh optimizer at start; exact moments/schedule/RNG on resume
batch: 3 repository prose,3 new-source prose/code,1 authored instruction,2 grounded,2 class-copy examples
withheld_cells: feedback_index == (source_index+2)%4; four opposite-class pairs excluded from both arms' draws
selection: Among64-step checkpoints, smallest new-source Tune loss subject to temporal32/32,class4/4,legacy-heldout3/3 and, for intervention arm,16/16 crossed feedback. Those legacy/diagnostic panels are exposed development gates, not a fresh final test.
final_sources: Score the already-declared final source set only after candidate choice is frozen. If no candidate meets gates, preserve failures and score predeclared terminal artifacts as failed exploratory candidates without promoting them.
exact_resume: Replay intervention steps129..256 in a separate process from checkpoint128 plus its bound control/selection companion; compare final latent/moment checkpoint, served artifact and selected artifact bytes.
geometry: Separate bounded relation-conditioned vector learner, ordinary signed-permutation fit with same supervision; not the numerical cause of prose results.
cost: Prompt ingestion plus generated-token loops; compare exact sequences before claiming speed; isolate zero-allocation readout from allocating recurrent updates.
